outcome.rationale: Trial tests novel RFA immunostimulation hypothesis without precedent. Control arm outcomes predictable from historical resection data. Intervention arm benefit depends on unproven immunological mechanism. Insufficient evidence to predict success or failure.

primary_rollup.rule: success=全部主要终点yes；fail=任一主要终点no；其余uncertain
primary_rollup.binarize_rule: uncertain 且 P>=0.5 记 yes、P<0.5 记 no 后再聚合（阈值缺失时的兜底口径，非模型原始判断）

value.estimand: Experimental arm: preoperative RFA plus resection; Control arm: resection alone; Population: CRLM patients with ≥3cm tumor; Timepoint: 3 years; Analysis: per-protocol
value.uncertainty: No direct evidence for RFA+resection combination; extrapolated from resection-alone and RFA-alone studies; immunostimulation effect unproven
value.rationale: Historical resection alone shows median OS 43-45 months. RFA immunostimulation hypothesis may add modest benefit if effective. Wide confidence intervals reflect uncertainty in combination therapy effect.

analysis_trace.trial_identification: NCT04798898 (ISCOLIM) - Randomized phase NA trial of preoperative RFA plus resection vs resection alone for colorectal liver metastases
analysis_trace.patient_population: Adults with resectable CRLM, ECOG 0-1, no cirrhosis, no extrahepatic metastases
analysis_trace.target_mechanism: RFA-induced partial tumor necrosis to stimulate immunogenic cell death and anti-tumor immunity
analysis_trace.endpoint_interpretation: Primary endpoint is median overall survival per arm over 3 years. Secondary endpoints include 1-, 2-, 3-year survival rates and recurrence rates at 1-3 years.
analysis_trace.safety_analysis: RFA-related complications include bleeding, bile leak, infection. Historical RFA complication rate ~6.7% minor, major complications rare.
analysis_trace.key_risks: 1) Immunostimulation hypothesis unproven in this setting; 2) RFA may increase local recurrence if margins inadequate; 3) Trial ongoing with no interim results available
analysis_trace.evidence_to_prediction: Based on retrieved studies: PMC11067153 (resection: median OS 43mo, 1-yr 91%, 3-yr 56%); PMC8790392 (resection: median OS 45mo, 1-yr 93.6%, 3-yr 65.8%); PMC10441159 (RFA alone: median 42mo for ≤3cm, 25mo for >3cm). No direct evidence for RFA+resection combination. Prediction assumes control arm achieves historical resection outcomes; intervention arm may show modest improvement if immunostimulation effective.
analysis_trace.coverage_gaps: No published results for NCT04798898. No randomized trials comparing RFA+resection vs resection alone. Immunostimulation effect size unknown. Extrapolation from RFA-alone or resection-alone studies to combination therapy introduces significant uncertainty.
